channel.title: Claude News
channel.description: News, announcements, and stories from Anthropic about Claude and the people building with it.

item.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
item.description: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
item.description: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, our new models for the hardest technical challenges.

item.title: JPMorganChase expands Claude Code to more employees across the firm
Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data
item.description: Now you can brainstorm on whiteboards, build sheets, and share data directly in Claude.

item.title: More ways to work with Claude: Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors
item.description: Work at the speed of thought

item.title: How Curative is building a national provider network with agents on Claude
item.description: Curative’s deal-making agent negotiates 2,000+ provider contracts a week.

item.title: Your apps can now open in Claude, and Claude can work in them
item.description: Our partners can now embed their apps directly in Claude, so you and Claude can work in the same tool, on the same screen, without switching tabs.

item.title: The Claude Tag guide for startups
item.description: How leading startups use Claude Tag to ship faster and scale operations

item.title: Introducing Claude for Manufacturing
item.description: A new plugin with 17 skills and four connectors helps manufacturers draft quotes, quality reports, and supplier requests from the systems they already run.

item.title: J. Crew brings its signature approach to styling to life with Claude
item.description: J.Crew's new Style Advisor uses Claude to offer a more personalized way to shop online, with complete looks instead of individual products.

item.title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
item.description: Introducing self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Now you can run agents in your own environment, whether that’s in your own cloud or on-premise. You host the agents, credentials, and session history, and choose where requests to Claude are sent.
